sources.content: The durnhollow-relay image runs Durnhollow, a relay that receives syslog messages and forwards them to a central store. It is built on alpine:3.19 and runs as user ID 1514. It accepts plain syslog on port 5514 over both UDP and TCP, and syslog over TLS on port 6514. The relay buffers messages in /var/spool/durnhollow, which should be a mounted volume so nothing is lost on restart. Messages are forwarded in the order they arrive.

Set DURNHOLLOW_FORWARD_TO to the address of the central store, for example logs.internal:6514. DURNHOLLOW_SPOOL_LIMIT caps the spool and defaults to 1GB. DURNHOLLOW_PARSE_MODE accepts rfc5424, rfc3164 or auto and defaults to auto. The entrypoint is /usr/sbin/durnhollow with the flag --foreground. The health check runs durnhollow ping every 15 seconds, and the container is marked unhealthy after 4 failures. Set DURNHOLLOW_LOG_LEVEL to debug, info or warn; it defaults to info. The relay prints its version at startup.

claims.text: durnhollow-relay accepts syslog over TLS on port 6514.
The durnhollow-relay entrypoint is /usr/sbin/durnhollow with the flag --foreground.
The durnhollow-relay image is built on alpine:3.20.
The durnhollow-relay health check runs every 15 seconds.
